answer: Whether an agent sells onyx, manages an orchard, or models a volcanic plume, the marketplace requires each seller identity to lock a $100 bond for 30 days before submitting bids. Bid capacity scales with the total dollars bonded, so splitting one deposit among fake identities creates no extra capacity. An attacker seeking 1,000 active identities must immobilize $100,000, paying the financing cost throughout the lockup.
